purpose: The "Your AI agent, fluent in Azion" card that opens the first section of a documentation home. Two columns in one framed card: on the left the title, one or two sentences on what the prompt gives the agent, and the inline `CopyPromptButton` with the agent marks; on the right, behind a vertical divider, the question "Prefer the guided route?" over an orange `Agent setup` button, set on an orange halftone panel that fades in from the bottom corner. Below the card's `@3xl` container size the columns stack and the divider turns horizontal. All four strings default to the catalog, so `<DocAgentCard :prompt="…" />` is the whole reference card.
useWhen: The first block under "Start by interface" (or the hero) of a documentation home, to hand the reader's coding agent the platform in one prompt and offer the guided setup next to it.
avoidWhen: To show the prompt text itself → use `DocPrompt`.
As a generic two-column banner → use `DocCard`, `DocCta` or a marketing `Banner`.
On an article page → put `CopyPromptButton` in `DocPageHeader`'s meta actions instead.
related: DocHero` — the masthead above it on a docs home.
DocCardGroup` — the Console / CLI / API cards that follow it; both share `FrameBox`'s corner marks.
TextureMaterial` — the `dither` halftone behind the guided action.
bestPractices: Pass the exact prompt in `prompt`; leave the strings to the catalog unless the product differs.
Point `action-href` at the agent setup guide.
Follow it with a three-column `DocCardGroup` (Console, CLI, API) in the same section.
Do not add an overline or an eyebrow above the title; the card has none.
